help

How to Use

search

Search Rooms

Type any room name, wing, or subject in the search bar to find it instantly. Press Enter or click a result to navigate.

map

View Map

Click the map button or "View Interactive Map" to open the full school floor plan. Toggle between Ground Floor and First Floor. Click any room chip to go straight there.

bookmark

Bookmarks

Save rooms you visit often with the bookmark button. Click "Save Current Room" in the bookmarks panel, then tap any saved room to jump back to it.

star

Favourite a Room

Press the star button to mark the current room as your favourite. It turns gold when active. Press again to unfavourite.

arrow_upward

Navigate

Use the arrow buttons at the bottom to move through the school. Forward moves you to the next area; left/right turn the view.

floor

Change Floor

Use the floor selector on the bottom right to switch between Ground Floor (G) and First Floor (1).

logout

Exit

The logout button and the home button both return you to the main search landing page.
